notes: This repo has no Colors By Brand admin code: no route, controller, view, migration or model for a core color flag, and is_core / 'CORE COLOR' never appear. The customizer only reads core_color from the external QX7 uniform resources payload. Admin requirements are therefore NOT_IMPLEMENTED here; they may be implemented in QX7, which was not audited. Picker features are gated by VITE_FEATURE_BUILDER_RESKIN (resources/js/stores/master-feature.js:54). The local .env line 291 sets it to true; .env.example does not define it.
